description: Fascinated by the cosmos and the stories written in the stars. Passionate about exploring NASA’s open data and uncovering the rich historical milestones that paved the way for modern space exploration.
summary: ARTEMIS & ARES: MISSION CONTROL is an interactive STEM web application inspired by NASA space exploration programs, designed for young explorers and space enthusiasts. The user takes on the role of the Space Outpost Commander, tasked with managing vital resources, building and upgrading base modules on an extraterrestrial surface, monitoring energy networks, and protecting the crew from hazards like solar radiation and micrometeorites
